chars.WIFE: a young Moroccan woman in her early twenties wearing a mustard-yellow hijab and a dusty-pink long tunic, round face, big brown eyes
chars.HUSBAND: a very tall skinny Moroccan man in his late twenties with short black hair and a thin moustache, wearing a grey shopkeeper work coat over a white t-shirt
chars.KIDS: two Moroccan neighbourhood boys about twelve years old, one in a red football jersey, one in a green football jersey

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Seen from the bedroom doorway: WIFE sits on a bed in a modest Moroccan bedroom filming a selfie video of herself with her phone held up, smiling and posing; HUSBAND stands in the doorway in the foreground edge, half turned, watching her with a tired frown. Head-to-waist framing on the wife, her face clearly visible.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: WIFE sits on the bed holding her phone to her chest, talking defensively with raised eyebrows and an open hand, explaining; HUSBAND sits on the edge of the bed beside her listening quietly. Warm lamp light, Moroccan bedroom.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Close medium shot of WIFE looking down at her phone, biting her lip, a guilty sideways glance, in a Moroccan bedroom at night.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: In a Moroccan living room with low sofas, WIFE stands with her hands joined, pleading and apologising with sad eyes; HUSBAND stands facing her with arms crossed, upset, still in his work coat.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: HUSBAND points firmly at the phone in WIFE's hands, stern face, giving a last warning; WIFE nods nervously, deleting things on the phone. Moroccan living room.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: HUSBAND alone behind the counter of his small Moroccan neighbourhood droguerie shop full of paint cans, brooms and shelves of products, staring worried at his phone, anxious expression.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: At the door of the small droguerie shop in a popular Moroccan derb street, KIDS lean in grinning and holding up a phone toward HUSBAND, calling him to come and look; HUSBAND behind the counter freezes, shocked and embarrassed.
